page.overview:
Who is The Unluckiest?

The Unluckiest is an unnamed planeswalker from an undefined plane, who is cursed with bad luck.

The bearded planeswalker is snazzy and sharp, but always in the wrong place at the wrong time. He has a knack of getting in trouble, yet always ends up not dying.

At some point, this planeswalker ran afoul of the Innistradi warlock Lynde, who is the source of his curses. She keeps a doll in his image, which she uses for dark magic. She describes him as the single most annoying person she has ever met in her exceptionally long life.

It has been speculated that, with his luck, the Unluckiest Planeswalker certainly would have ended up on Ravnica during the War of the Spark, although this has not been confirmed.
